landmarks.name: white bed
landmarks.description: Large bed with white linens and pillows set against a freestanding beige partial-height partition wall.

landmarks.name: triple black-framed window
landmarks.description: Three-panel horizontal window with dark frames and half-lowered blinds.

landmarks.name: bedhead partition wall
landmarks.description: Freestanding beige partial-height wall separating the white bed from the sink and shower area.

landmarks.name: towel radiator
landmarks.description: White vertical ladder-style heated towel rail mounted on the wall near the double white vanity.

landmarks.name: double white vanity
landmarks.description: Wall-mounted tiered white counter with two vessel sinks and mirrors.

landmarks.name: walk-in shower behind partition
landmarks.description: Long white floor tray with a tiled wall featuring vertical mosaic strips on the back of the bedhead partition wall.

landmarks.name: horizontal ribbon window
landmarks.description: Wide, short black-framed window mounted high on the beige tiled wall between the two sinks of the double white vanity.

landmarks.name: wicker laundry basket
landmarks.description: Round woven basket on the floor beneath the horizontal ribbon window.

landmarks.name: wall-mounted TV between two doorways
landmarks.description: Black flat-screen TV on a white wall flanked by two open doorways opposite the white bed.

landmarks.name: white shelving and hanging rods with drawers
landmarks.description: L-shaped built-in cream/white storage system with central drawers, open shelves, and hanging clothes rods behind the wall with the two doorways.

landmarks.name: wood-look desk and black chair
landmarks.description: L-shaped light wood-grain desk with a black rolling chair near the upper stair landing.

landmarks.name: diamond-grid wood bookcase
landmarks.description: Large square shelving unit with diagonal grey-brown wood dividers forming diamond-shaped cubbies.

landmarks.name: black low cabinet
landmarks.description: Small black floor-standing cabinet with silver handles next to the diamond-grid bookcase.

landmarks.name: glossy white flush door
landmarks.description: Smooth reflective white door in a light grey frame next to the black low cabinet and desk area.

landmarks.name: glass and black metal stair railing
landmarks.description: Staircase balustrade with black metal posts and glass panels along the stairs and upper landing.

landmarks.name: floating wood steps with black central stringer
landmarks.description: Open-riser staircase with thick light wood treads supported by a single black metal beam underneath.

landmarks.name: tall multi-pane window at stair landing
landmarks.description: Floor-to-ceiling black-framed window with horizontal transoms at the base of the stairs.

landmarks.name: wall-mounted TV over low console
landmarks.description: Flat-screen TV above a low light-coloured media cabinet near the base of the stairs.

landmarks.name: round black wall-mounted fireplace
landmarks.description: Circular glossy black fireplace with a central firebox mounted on the light wall next to the TV console.

landmarks.name: wide black-framed glass doors
landmarks.description: Large grid-style sliding glass doors leading to a terrace near the grey sectional sofa and white island.

landmarks.name: round black-and-white lounge chair
landmarks.description: Low rounded swivel armchair with a black base, white seat, and grey patterned backrest.

landmarks.name: large grey sectional sofa
landmarks.description: L-shaped light grey upholstered sofa facing the TV and fireplace.

landmarks.name: silver tufted cube pouf
landmarks.description: Small square metallic silver upholstered ottoman on the floor near the floating wood steps.

landmarks.name: exposed stone wall with opening
landmarks.description: Light-coloured rough stone wall with a wide floor-to-ceiling doorway and a rectangular cutout.

landmarks.name: sink counter with glossy beige drawers
landmarks.description: Long white-topped counter with glossy beige lower cabinets and a chrome faucet set against the back of the exposed stone wall beneath the rectangular cutout.

landmarks.name: white island with barstools
landmarks.description: White counter with metal barstools in front of tall beige cabinets.

landmarks.name: tall beige cabinet wall with built-in ovens
landmarks.description: Floor-to-ceiling flat-front beige cabinets with two stainless steel built-in appliances behind the white island.

landmarks.name: dining table with chairs
landmarks.description: Rectangular table with light-coloured chairs next to the exposed stone wall.

landmarks.name: recessed windows with wooden sills
landmarks.description: Two deep-set vertical black-framed windows with warm wooden sills alongside the dining table.

landmarks.name: built-in glass-front wine cabinets
landmarks.description: Three stainless-trimmed glass-door cooler units recessed into the wall past the dining table.

landmarks.name: vertical plant wall
landmarks.description: Square wall-mounted greenery installation above a grey rectangular planter box.

landmarks.name: black double front door with sidelight
landmarks.description: Matte black entrance door with a tall vertical glass panel on the right.

landmarks.name: dark-framed square wall art
landmarks.description: Thick dark brown wooden frame with a small light square center near the vertical plant wall.

landmarks.name: wall-mounted toilet with dark mosaic backing
landmarks.description: White toilet mounted against a narrow vertical strip of dark blue/black mosaic tiles inside a small doorway near the plant wall.

landmarks.name: built-in coat racks and shoe shelves
landmarks.description: Wood-grain open shelving and hanging rods filled with coats, boots, and bags in an alcove off the narrow lower corridor.

landmarks.name: light wood-grain door with horizontal grooves
landmarks.description: Flush light grey-brown wood-grain door with horizontal recessed lines in the narrow lower corridor.

landmarks.name: narrow wood-grain shelving and drawers
landmarks.description: Floor-to-ceiling grey-brown wood-grain open shelves and handleless drawers lining a narrow storage area.

landmarks.name: small black-framed vertical window
landmarks.description: Deeply recessed small vertical window with a black frame at the end of the narrow wood-grain shelving area.

landmarks.name: white molded chair with wood legs
landmarks.description: White plastic bucket-style chair with light wooden legs beside the double black-framed glass doors.

landmarks.name: dark wood platform bed with white bedding
landmarks.description: Low dark brown wooden bed frame with a curved headboard and white duvet.

landmarks.name: elliptical trainer
landmarks.description: Silver and black upright exercise machine in the corner next to the dark wood bed and double glass doors.

landmarks.name: double black-framed glass doors
landmarks.description: Full-height black-framed double glass doors divided into three horizontal panes each, with a black roller blind housing above.

landmarks.name: grey tiled walk-in shower with vertical mosaic strips
landmarks.description: Walk-in shower area with beige mosaic floor tiles, large grey wall tiles, and two vertical dark mosaic tile strips adjacent to the dark wood platform bed.

landmarks.name: white ladder towel warmer
landmarks.description: White vertical heated towel rail mounted on the light wall next to the grey tiled walk-in shower.

landmarks.name: small frosted window in grey tile wall
landmarks.description: Recessed vertical black-framed frosted window set into the grey tiled shower wall.

landmarks.name: framed wall art by stairs
landmarks.description: Rectangular brown-framed picture mounted high on the wall near the top of the stairs.

landmarks.name: wall-mounted toilet with dark brown tile backing
landmarks.description: White wall-hung toilet against a dark brown tiled half-wall with a tall green plant on top, inside a doorway off the upper passage.

landmarks.name: white bed with grey patterned bedding
landmarks.description: Light-colored wooden bed frame with grey, black, and white patterned duvet set against a dark blue wall.

landmarks.name: white chest of drawers with plush toys
landmarks.description: Distressed white wooden dresser topped with blue and yellow stuffed animals.

landmarks.name: small black-framed interior windows
landmarks.description: Two vertical rectangular windows with thick black frames set into a white interior wall along a narrow passage.

landmarks.name: dark blue round pouf
landmarks.description: Small round dark blue upholstered footstool on short legs at the corner of the passage with the interior windows.

landmarks.name: black glass sliding-door wardrobes
landmarks.description: Floor-to-ceiling wardrobes with glossy black glass panels divided by horizontal silver strips.

landmarks.name: black wall-mounted vanity against turquoise tiles
landmarks.description: Glossy black floating sink cabinet and wide rectangular mirror mounted on a turquoise tiled wall opposite the black glass wardrobes.

landmarks.name: blue wall with skateboarder graffiti mural
landmarks.description: Large dark blue wall painted with a colorful graffiti mural of a cartoon character on a skateboard.

landmarks.name: long built-in desk and shelving under mural
landmarks.description: Light-colored long desk and open cubby shelves with a blue-and-black office chair beneath the graffiti mural.

landmarks.name: white door with horizontal grooves
landmarks.description: White interior door with horizontal recessed lines and a silver handle leading to the area with the purple floral bed.

landmarks.name: bed with purple floral bedding
landmarks.description: Double bed covered with a dark blue and purple floral-patterned bedspread.

landmarks.name: wood-top vanity with white vessel sink
landmarks.description: Open wooden counter with a rectangular white vessel sink and a wood-framed mirror above.

landmarks.name: white tiled shower with mosaic strip
landmarks.description: Walk-in shower with large white wall tiles, a vertical multi-colored mosaic tile strip, and a chrome shower bar next to the wood-top vanity.

landmarks.name: white chest of drawers with TV
landmarks.description: White dresser with a black flat-screen TV on top, positioned opposite the purple floral bed.

landmarks.name: white sliding-door wardrobe with frosted stripe
landmarks.description: Built-in two-door white wardrobe with a horizontal frosted grey glass band across the middle.

landmarks.name: white armoire with arched mirror
landmarks.description: Freestanding white wardrobe cabinet with a full-length arched mirror on the door next to the sliding-door wardrobe.

walk_summary: Start by entering past the white bed and bedhead partition wall on the right, looping behind the partition past the triple black-framed window and walk-in shower behind partition to face the double white vanity, towel radiator, horizontal ribbon window, and wicker laundry basket.

Turn around at the double white vanity, walk back past the white bed on the left toward the wall-mounted TV between two doorways, and turn right through the doorway past the wood-look desk and black chair.

Turn left at the glass and black metal stair railing and descend the floating wood steps with black central stringer toward the tall multi-pane window at stair landing, wall-mounted TV over low console, and wide black-framed glass doors.

Turn right at the bottom of the stairs, pass the large grey sectional sofa on the left, go through the exposed stone wall with opening, and turn right past the white island with barstools, dining table with chairs, and built-in glass-front wine cabinets to reach the vertical plant wall and black double front door with sidelight.

Turn right past the dark-framed square wall art to look at the wall-mounted toilet with dark mosaic backing, then step back and turn left into the narrow corridor to view the built-in coat racks and shoe shelves.

Continue down the corridor past the light wood-grain door with horizontal grooves, turn left into the passage with narrow wood-grain shelving and drawers to the small black-framed vertical window, then exit and turn left past the dark wood platform bed with white bedding, white molded chair with wood legs, and elliptical trainer to the double black-framed glass doors.

Turn around and walk straight back down the narrow corridor toward the black double front door with sidelight, turn left past the dining table with chairs, and turn left through the exposed stone wall with opening to return to the floating wood steps with black central stringer.

Climb the stairs past the tall multi-pane window at stair landing and glass and black metal stair railing to the upper landing, walk past the diamond-grid wood bookcase into the white bed area, and turn right through the doorway by the wall-mounted TV between two doorways to see the white shelving and hanging rods with drawers.
Turn around, exit past the white bed and diamond-grid wood bookcase, and approach the glossy white flush door beside the black low cabinet and wood-look desk and black chair.

Turn right away from the glossy white flush door, walk past the framed wall art by stairs and glass and black metal stair railing into the upper passage, and turn right into the doorway with the wall-mounted toilet with dark brown tile backing.

Exit the toilet doorway, walk forward past the white bed with grey patterned bedding and white chest of drawers with plush toys, and continue past the small black-framed interior windows and dark blue round pouf to the black glass sliding-door wardrobes and black wall-mounted vanity against turquoise tiles.

Turn around, walk back past the small black-framed interior windows, loop around the white bed with grey patterned bedding past the blue wall with skateboarder graffiti mural and long built-in desk and shelving under mural, and exit past the white chest of drawers with plush toys into the upper passage.

Turn left through the doorway with the white door with horizontal grooves, pass the bed with purple floral bedding, and turn right past the wood-top vanity with white vessel sink into the white tiled shower with mosaic strip.

Step out of the shower area and turn left to walk between the bed with purple floral bedding and the white chest of drawers with TV toward the white sliding-door wardrobe with frosted stripe and white armoire with arched mirror.

Turn around, walk back past the bed with purple floral bedding, turn right through the doorway with the white door with horizontal grooves, walk past the framed wall art by stairs, and descend the floating wood steps with black central stringer.

At the bottom of the stairs, walk past the wall-mounted TV over low console to face the round black wall-mounted fireplace, then turn right and circle between the round black-and-white lounge chair, wide black-framed glass doors, and large grey sectional sofa.

Walk through the exposed stone wall with opening, turn left around the white island with barstools and tall beige cabinet wall with built-in ovens, then turn around and walk past the dining table with chairs, recessed windows with wooden sills, and built-in glass-front wine cabinets to the vertical plant wall.

Turn right at the vertical plant wall, walk back alongside the dining table with chairs and exposed stone wall with opening, turn left through the stone opening past the large grey sectional sofa and silver tufted cube pouf, then turn around and go back through the stone wall opening past the dining table and wine cabinets to the vertical plant wall.

Turn left into the narrow corridor past the light wood-grain door with horizontal grooves, built-in coat racks and shoe shelves, and narrow wood-grain shelving and drawers toward the dark wood platform bed with white bedding and double black-framed glass doors, then turn right into the doorway to view the grey tiled walk-in shower with vertical mosaic strips, white ladder towel warmer, and small frosted window in grey tile wall.

Step out of the shower area, walk back down the corridor to the black double front door with sidelight, turn left past the built-in glass-front wine cabinets and dining table with chairs, and turn left through the exposed stone wall with opening to walk between the large grey sectional sofa and silver tufted cube pouf up to the tall multi-pane window at stair landing.

Turn around at the tall multi-pane window, walk back between the large grey sectional sofa and silver tufted cube pouf through the exposed stone wall with opening, and turn left between the white island with barstools and the stone wall to finish facing the sink counter with glossy beige drawers.
